faq: How much does the Grand Voyage 42 catamaran cost? | 25,000 THB for a 3-hour sunset sail, 35,000 THB for a 5-hour half day and 55,000 THB for a 10-hour full day, each for the whole boat with up to 10 guests.
How many guests can sail on the Grand Voyage 42? | Up to 15. The price covers 10 guests; guests 11 to 15 cost 1,000 THB each, which we add on WhatsApp after you book.
Does the Grand Voyage 42 leave from Koh Samui? | No. It sails from Ban Tai on Koh Phangan's south coast. From Koh Samui you need a ferry or a private speedboat; we can quote the speedboat crossing.

Which beaches can the Grand Voyage 42 visit? | The west coast route covers Koh Tae Nai, Zen Beach, Haad Salad, Mae Haad and Koh Ma; the east coast route covers Haad Rin, Haad Yuan, Than Sadet, Thong Nai Pan and Bottle Beach. The captain picks the side with calmer water on the day.
Is food included on the Grand Voyage 42 charter? | Soft drinks, ice and seasonal fruit are included. Meals, a private chef and alcohol can be arranged at extra cost if you ask when booking.
Can children sail on the Grand Voyage 42? | Yes. Life jackets are on board and the catamaran sails flat and steady. Count children and infants in your guest total when you book.

What happens if the Grand Voyage 42 sail is cancelled for weather? | If the captain cancels for sea safety you choose a full refund or a new date. If you cancel, you get a full refund 48 hours or more before departure, 50 % at 24–48 hours and nothing under 24 hours.
Can we stay overnight on the Grand Voyage 42? | The boat has 3 cabins and overnight charters are possible, but they are priced on request. Message us on WhatsApp with your dates and group size.

faq: What does the Orana catamaran charter cost? | 43,000 THB for the 4-hour morning sail, 46,000 THB for the 4-hour afternoon sail, 57,500 THB for 6 hours and 64,000 THB for 8 hours, per boat for up to 10 guests.
How many people fit on the Orana? | Up to 20. Prices cover 10 guests; each extra guest is 500 THB on a half day or 1,000 THB on a full day.
Is hotel pickup included on the Orana charter? | Yes, a return hotel transfer on Koh Samui is included. We confirm the pier and pickup time on WhatsApp after booking.
Is lunch served on the Orana? | Lunch is included on the 6-hour and 8-hour charters for up to 10 guests. The 4-hour sails include soft drinks, light snacks and fruit only.
Which islands does the Orana visit? | Every option visits Koh Madsum (Pig Island) and Koh Tan. The 8-hour full day adds Koh Rap.
Does the Orana actually sail or use engines? | Both. It sails when the wind suits and uses its twin diesels otherwise, cruising at 8–10 knots.

Can I cancel an Orana booking? | Yes: full refund 48 hours or more before departure, 50 % at 24–48 hours, none under 24 hours. If the captain cancels for weather you choose a full refund or a new date.

Is the Orana suitable for families with small children? | Yes. A catamaran is wide and stable, there is shade, an air-conditioned saloon and a freshwater shower, and life jackets are provided. Include infants in your guest count.

Where does the Super King depart from? | Thong Krut pier on Samui's south coast, the closest pier to Pig Island and Koh Tan. A return hotel transfer is included.
Can we barbecue on the Super King? | Yes, there is a BBQ grill on board. The food is not included; we can quote catering or you can bring your own.
Does the Super King go to Ang Thong in November? | No. The park is closed 1 November–15 December; the Ang Thong option runs from 16 December. The park fee of 300 THB adult / 150 THB child is extra.

Can large families with kids book the Super King? | Yes. Count every child and infant in the total so we can confirm the boat and life jackets.

faq: How much is the private catamaran to Pig Island? | 27,000 THB for the whole boat for about 8.5 hours, for up to 10 guests. Split between 8 people that is about 3,375 THB each.
How many people can join the private Pig Island catamaran? | Up to 10 guests, including children and infants.

Which islands does the Pig Island catamaran visit? | Koh Rap for the beach, Koh Tan for snorkelling and Koh Madsum (Pig Island) to see the pigs, in the order the captain judges best for the tide and wind.
Is lunch included on the private Pig Island catamaran? | No. Soft drinks, water and fruit are on board. Bring a cool bag with lunch, or eat at a beach restaurant on the islands.
Do you collect us from our hotel for the Pig Island catamaran? | Hotel transfers are not included. Tell us on WhatsApp and we arrange a private transfer for your group at extra cost.
Is a sailing catamaran good if I get seasick? | It is steadier than a speedboat or longtail, so it is a good choice if you are prone to seasickness. Take a tablet before you leave if you are unsure.
Can we finish the Pig Island catamaran trip at sunset? | A sunset return can be requested when you book, depending on the season and your start time.
